text: おはな　なんか　いけてる　から　おとなしそうに　みえるが　てごわい　あいてに　なるぞ！
note: The flower arranging is ikebana, a traditional Japanese art long seen as a refined accomplishment for well-bred young women, which is why it makes Erika seem gentle.
claim: Ikebana is the traditional Japanese art of flower arrangement.
